nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: SARS-CoV-2, Influenza A and RSV are in the “High” category nationwide. The other respiratory viruses (Influenza B, HMPV and EV-D68) we monitor remain in the “Low” wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/UK4zUeRU3W

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the “High” category with medium concentrations and an upward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/1XJ87ZKLXS

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (51.6%) and KP.3 in light blue (14.3%) make up approximately 66% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/GB3ehMO0EC

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A is in the “High” category with high concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. Flu B is in the “Low” category nationally but is nearing onset. https://t.co/HrmIzLsUO6

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 detected in 25 states since monitoring began - 6 in West, 7 in Midwest, 6 in South, and 6 in Northeast. As of 3/25/25, 17 states have also reported infected cattle herds. Recent wastewater detections in March 2025 have been in AK, CA, FL, MA, MN, & NJ. https://t.co/GjcDYS0d6d

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations with a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/pbwSTSESLZ

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the “Low” category nationally, but is in onset and in the “High” category in some regions (West and Northeast). https://t.co/5EueyE6OIm

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the “High” category nationally with high concentrations and no significant up or down trend over the last 3 weeks. All regions except the West remain in the “High” category. https://t.co/hsdSNC7KWo
